fact: Law 33/AN/18 (Assembly session 2018/2019) adopts the national standardisation system, names national standards ND, and provides for creating a national standards body, the ADN, later created by Law 100/AN/20.
title: Loi n° 33/AN/18/8ème L portant adoption du système national de normalisation et de promotion de la qualité
publisher: Journal Officiel de la République de Djibouti
